name: fan-stack
title: Fan Stack
description: A loose pile of pictures that fans out like a hand of cards; tap one to lift it out of the fan.

perf.budget: Three springs per card (fan, lift, dim), transforms and opacity only. Nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: Cards move straight to the fan or the pile without the stagger or the bounce.
a11y.screenReader: Gathered, the pile is one button ('Photos, 5 items'); fanned, every card is a button with a selected state.
a11y.touchTarget: Cards are 148 by 192 pt by default; overlapping cards keep at least 60 pt of their width uncovered.
